entries.title: Psalms 84:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.>> How lovely [is] Your tabernacle, O LORD of hosts!

entries.title: Psalms 84:2
segments: My soul longs, yes, even faints For the courts of the LORD; My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

entries.title: Psalms 84:3
segments: Even the sparrow has found a home, And the swallow a nest for herself, Where she may lay her young-[Even] Your altars, O LORD of hosts, My King and my God.

entries.title: Psalms 84:4
segments: Blessed [are] those who dwell in Your house; They will still be praising You. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 84:5
segments: Blessed [is] the man whose strength [is] in You, Whose heart [is] set on pilgrimage.

entries.title: Psalms 84:6
segments: [As they] pass through the Valley of Baca, They make it a spring; The rain also covers it with pools.

entries.title: Psalms 84:7
segments: They go from strength to strength; [Each one] appears before God in Zion.

entries.title: Psalms 84:8
segments: ¶O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer; Give ear, O God of Jacob! Selah

entries.title: Psalms 84:9
segments: O God, behold our shield, And look upon the face of Your anointed.

entries.title: Psalms 84:10
segments: For a day in Your courts [is] better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God Than dwell in the tents of wickedness.

entries.title: Psalms 84:11
segments: For the LORD God [is] a sun and shield; The LORD will give grace and glory; No good [thing] will He withhold From those who walk uprightly.

entries.title: Psalms 84:12
segments: O LORD of hosts, Blessed [is] the man who trusts in You!
